import pandas as pd

# List all source file paths

    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_49/test_13.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_49/test_14.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)  # ignore the first index column as per hint 24
    # Ensure the column emp_title is integer type as in target schema
    df['emp_title'] = df['emp_title'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the exact same schema ['emp_title'] as the target,
# and the target schema is also ['emp_title'], we can simply concatenate (union) all rows.
# This matches Hint 2 and Hint 4.

# Concatenate all source DataFrames vertically (union)
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target examples show emp_title values mostly as 1, but source values are different.
# The prompt does not specify any transformation on emp_title values.
# So we keep the values as is.

# Write the resulting DataFrame to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_49/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
